record_type_quote: We conduct a computational replication of the main results of the paper using the same procedures and original data.

targets.authors: Dertwinkel-Kalt, M., Gerhardt, H., Riener, G., Schwerter, F. and Strang, L.
targets.title: Concentration bias in intertemporal choice
targets.evidence_quote: In the present paper, we investigate the computational reproducibility of DGRSS’s empirical results.
targets.outcome_computational_quote: We successfully reproduce all five of DGRSS’s main results when we use the measures of concentration bias provided by the authors.
targets.outcome_robustness_quote: We extend our analysis (where possible) to compute our own measure of concentration bias from subject’s choice data. The analysis yields results that are closely aligned to those reported DGRSS. Small differences only occur at the third decimal point. This does not change the economic or statistical significance of the original study’s findings.
targets.outcome_reasoning: All main results reproduced; reconstruction of the outcome measure leaves substantive and statistical conclusions unchanged. Raw data limitations restrict reconstruction in some conditions but do not overturn the obtained results.

reasoning: Reanalysis of original data, with independent reconstruction of an outcome variable where possible; one target paper.
